query: INSERT INTO messaging.text_retry (outbox_id, failures, first_failed_at) SELECT id, GREATEST(attempts, 1), $2 FROM messaging.outbox WHERE id = $1 AND status IN ('queued', 'sending') ON CONFLICT (outbox_id) DO UPDATE SET failures = GREATEST(EXCLUDED.failures, messaging.text_retry.failures) WHERE messaging.text_retry.outcome IS NULL RETURNING failures, first_failed_at
